parameters.name: size
parameters.description: How many messages make a batch.

parameters.name: within
parameters.description: How long after its first message a batch goes out, however few it has.

verbs.description: Gathers messages into a Batched message: so many at a time, or whatever has come within a while of the first, whichever is first. In Meeplang: Batch 100, Batch within=1s, or Batch 100 within=1s.

parameters.name: tree
parameters.description: The name of the classification tree to classify with, the same as Learn's.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text to classify, worked out for each message. Without it, the message's own text.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The file the tree is saved in, if Learn was given one.

parameters.name: min-training
parameters.description: How many documents a class must have learned before Classify will choose it, so a class taught only a few times doesn't win by chance. 10 unless set (Q145).

parameters.name: against
parameters.description: Classes to score the others against, separated by commas, such as "Ham" for a spam filter (Q147). Each other class is then scored against these alone, and these are never the class emitted.

verbs.description: Works out which class of a named classification tree each message belongs to, from what Learn has taught the tree, and emits a ClassifiedMessage with the class and its score. In Meeplang: Classify "topics", then perhaps Where msg.Score > 0.9; or Classify "mail" against="Ham".

parameters.name: copies
parameters.description: How many copies of the branch to make, at least 2.

parameters.name: by
parameters.description: The key that decides a message's copy, so messages with the same key keep their order.

verbs.description: Spreads messages across copies of the branch below it, so a slow module runs side by side, while messages with the same key always take the same copy and keep their order (Q53). In Meeplang: Distribute 4 by msg.CustomerId, with the branch indented under it.

parameters.name: book
parameters.description: The book to read from, such as "Countries", or "Plugin.Book" for a plugin's.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Which item to emit, worked out for each message, counting from 0 and wrapping around the end. Without it, the items in order, one for each message.

parameters.name: all
parameters.description: Emits every item in the book, in order, for each message, instead of one.

verbs.description: Emits an item from a book in the library for each message it receives, as a BookItem. In Meeplang: Enumerate "Countries" to step through a book in order, one item for each message, or Enumerate "Lorem Ipsum" index=msg.Count to choose the item, or Enumerate "Common Passwords" all=true for every item.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The JSONPath query, such as $.departures[*].

verbs.description: Reads a message's content as JSON and emits a JsonMessage for each value a JSONPath query matches. In Meeplang: Extract "$.departures[*]".

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The address to fetch, worked out for each message.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: How long to wait for the whole response. 100 seconds unless set.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Leaves a successful response's body unread, for one module to read, such as Send passing it on to a client without holding it all in memory (Q51). The connection stays open until then. Only HTTP streams.

parameters.name: max-size
parameters.description: The largest body to read, in bytes. 16 MiB unless set.

verbs.description: Fetch's File inflection: reads a file for each message it receives, and emits it as FileText. In Meeplang: Fetch "~/config/stops.json" or Fetch "file:///var/data/stops.json".

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The address to fetch, worked out for each message.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: How long to wait for the whole response. 100 seconds unless set.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Leaves a successful response's body unread, for one module to read, such as Send passing it on to a client without holding it all in memory (Q51). The connection stays open until then. Only HTTP streams.

parameters.name: max-size
parameters.description: The largest body to read, in bytes. 16 MiB unless set.

verbs.description: Fetch's HTTP inflection: fetches a web address for each message it receives, and emits the response as HttpResponse. In Meeplang: Fetch "https://api.example.com/stops/{msg.StopId}".

parameters.name: tree
parameters.description: The name of the classification tree, the same as Learn's.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: The one class to forget, worked out for each message. Without it, everything.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The file the tree is saved in, if Learn was given one.

verbs.description: Makes a named classification tree forget everything it has learned, or one class, then passes the message on. In Meeplang: Forget "topics", or Forget "topics" class="Science".

parameters.name: period
parameters.description: How long between ticks.

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: How many ticks to emit before finishing. Without it, Interval runs until stopped.

parameters.name: count-start
parameters.description: The number of the first tick, such as 0 to match Enumerate's index (Q163). 1 unless set. It doesn't change how many ticks Count emits.

parameters.name: payload
parameters.description: Text to put in each tick, for telling intervals apart.

verbs.description: Emits a Tick straight away, then again every period, until stopped or until it has emitted count ticks. In Meeplang: Interval 1m or Interval 500ms count=3. Ticks are numbered from 1, or from count-start, as in Interval 1s count-start=0.

parameters.name: tree
parameters.description: The name of the classification tree to teach, the same as Classify's. Starting it with shared: shares it with every pipeline.

parameters.name: class
parameters.description: The class the message belongs to, such as "Science", worked out for each message.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The text to learn from, worked out for each message. Without it, the message's own text.

parameters.name: file
parameters.description: The file to save the tree in, instead of the one in ~/.meep/trees.

parameters.name: save-every
parameters.description: How many documents to learn between saves. 5 unless set; 0 keeps the tree in memory only.

verbs.description: Teaches a named classification tree that each message belongs to a class, then passes the message on. Classify reads the same tree by its name. In Meeplang: Learn "topics" class="Science", or Learn "shared:topics" class=msg.section text=msg.body.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The address to listen at, such as http://0.0.0.0:8080/quote/. Host 0.0.0.0 listens on every network, and the path says which requests are this Listen's: those to it and below it.

parameters.name: certificate
parameters.description: The certificate for an https:// address: a PEM file, or a PKCS#12 file (.pfx or .p12) without a password.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The certificate's private key, as a PEM file, when it isn't in the certificate's own file.

parameters.name: max-size
parameters.description: The largest request body to read, in bytes. 16 MiB unless set.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: Leaves request bodies unread, for one module to read (Q51).

parameters.name: default-status
parameters.description: The status of the reply sent to a request nothing answered (Q50). 500 unless set.

parameters.name: default-reply
parameters.description: The text of the reply sent to a request nothing answered.

verbs.description: Listen's HTTP inflection: a source that receives HTTP and HTTPS requests and emits each one as an HttpRequest carrying a lease on its connection. In Meeplang: Listen "http://0.0.0.0:8080/quote/", then Send to reply.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The address to listen at, such as tcp://0.0.0.0:7000. Host 0.0.0.0 listens on every network.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The text that ends each message, such as "\r\n.\r\n". It isn't part of the message, and the connection stays open for more. Without it, or Length, each line is a message.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: The size of every message, in bytes, for a protocol whose messages are all the same length.

parameters.name: connections
parameters.description: Also emits TcpConnected and TcpDisconnected as clients come and go.

parameters.name: max-size
parameters.description: The longest message to read, in bytes. 1 MiB unless set, or Length if that's longer.

verbs.description: Listen's TCP inflection: a source that accepts TCP connections and emits each message that arrives on one as a TcpMessage carrying a lease on its connection. In Meeplang: Listen "tcp://0.0.0.0:7000".

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The address to listen at, such as ws://0.0.0.0:8080/chat/. Host 0.0.0.0 listens on every network, and the path says which connections are this Listen's: those to it and below it.

parameters.name: certificate
parameters.description: The certificate for a wss:// address: a PEM file, or a PKCS#12 file (.pfx or .p12) without a password.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: The certificate's private key, as a PEM file, when it isn't in the certificate's own file.

parameters.name: origins
parameters.description: The pages that may connect, besides those on Listen's own host: origins separated by commas, such as "https://a.example, https://b.example", or "*" for any (Q151).

parameters.name: connections
parameters.description: Also emits WebSocketConnected and WebSocketDisconnected as clients come and go.

parameters.name: max-size
parameters.description: The longest message to read, in bytes. 1 MiB unless set.

parameters.name: ping
parameters.description: How often to ping each client, closing connections that stop answering. 30 seconds unless set; 0 turns it off.

parameters.name: idle-timeout
parameters.description: Closes a connection nothing has been sent or received on for this long. Off unless set.

parameters.name: max-queued
parameters.description: How many messages each connection queues to send before dropping more (Q153). 256 unless set.

verbs.description: Listen's WebSocket inflection: a source that accepts WebSocket connections and emits each message that arrives on one as a WebSocketText or WebSocketBinary, carrying a lease on its connection. In Meeplang: Listen "ws://0.0.0.0:8080/chat/" as Room, then Send to reply, or Send "Room" to send to every connection.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The file to read.

verbs.description: Reads a text file once and emits its contents as FileText. In Meeplang: Read "~/notes.txt". A leading ~ means your home folder; other relative paths start from the current folder.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: The file to save to, worked out for each message.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Whether to add a line to the end of the file or replace it. Append unless set.

verbs.description: Saves each message's text to a file, adding a line to the end by default. A passthrough module: messages carry on downstream straight away. In Meeplang: Save "~/bus/{msg.Created:yyyy-MM-dd}.jsonl".

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: The name of the Listen.WebSocket to send to, as given with as.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: What to send, worked out for each message. Without it, Send sends the message itself.

verbs.description: Send's Broadcast inflection: sends each message to every client connected to a Listen.WebSocket, named with as (Q152). In Meeplang: Listen "ws://0.0.0.0:8080/chat/" as Room, then Send "Room".

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The address to POST to, worked out for each message.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: The body to send, worked out for each message. Without it, Send sends the message itself.

parameters.name: content-type
parameters.description: The body's media type. Without it, the message's own, or text.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: How long to wait for the whole response. 100 seconds unless set.

parameters.name: max-size
parameters.description: The largest response body to read, in bytes. 16 MiB unless set.

verbs.description: Send's HTTP inflection: POSTs each message to an http:// or https:// address, and emits the response as HttpResponse, as Fetch does for GET. In Meeplang: Send "https://api.example.com/claims".

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: What to send, worked out for each message. Without it, Send sends the message itself.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: The HTTP status: 200 unless set.

parameters.name: content-type
parameters.description: The HTTP media type. Without it, the message's own, or text.

parameters.name: error-reply
parameters.description: What to send for an error, worked out from the error (Q98).

parameters.name: error-status
parameters.description: The HTTP status for an error: 500 unless set.

parameters.name: details
parameters.description: Sends everything known about an error, instead of ErrorReply: its description, and the exception behind it. Meant for tools and testing, since it can show internal details to whoever asked.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: What to write after the text on a TCP connection. Without it, what ends the connection's own messages: a line break, or the end its Listen or Send was given.

parameters.name: final
parameters.description: Closes the connection after writing to it.

verbs.description: Send without an address replies to where a message came from, through its lease: an HTTP response for a request from Listen.HTTP, or a message on a connection from Listen.TCP, Listen.WebSocket or Send itself. In Meeplang: Send text="Hello, {msg.Query['name']}", or Send to send the message itself back.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The address to send to, such as tcp://printer.local:9100, worked out for each message.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: What to send, worked out for each message. Without it, Send sends the message's text.

parameters.name: end
parameters.description: The text that ends each message, both ways, such as "\r\n.\r\n". Without it, or Length, each line is a message.

parameters.name: length
parameters.description: The size of every message from the server, in bytes, for a protocol whose messages are all the same length.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: How long to wait for a message to be sent, connecting included. 30 seconds unless set.

parameters.name: tries
parameters.description: How many times to try connecting before giving up (Q157). 3 unless set.

parameters.name: retry-delay
parameters.description: How long to wait between tries. 1 second unless set.

parameters.name: connections
parameters.description: Also emits TcpConnected and TcpDisconnected as the connection opens and ends.

parameters.name: max-size
parameters.description: The longest message to read from the server, in bytes. 1 MiB unless set, or Length if that's longer.

verbs.description: Send's TCP inflection: writes each message to a tcp:// address, and emits what the server sends back as TcpMessage. In Meeplang: Send "tcp://printer.local:9100" text="{msg.Text}".

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The address to send to, such as wss://feed.example.com/prices, worked out for each message.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: What to send, worked out for each message. Without it, Send sends the message itself.

parameters.name: timeout
parameters.description: How long to wait for a message to be sent, connecting included. 30 seconds unless set.

parameters.name: tries
parameters.description: How many times to try connecting before giving up (Q157). 3 unless set.

parameters.name: retry-delay
parameters.description: How long to wait between tries. 1 second unless set.

parameters.name: connections
parameters.description: Also emits WebSocketConnected and WebSocketDisconnected as the connection opens and ends.

parameters.name: max-size
parameters.description: The longest message to read from the server, in bytes. 1 MiB unless set.

parameters.name: ping
parameters.description: How often to ping the server, closing the connection if it stops answering. 30 seconds unless set; 0 turns it off.

parameters.name: max-queued
parameters.description: How many messages the connection queues to send, beyond which Send waits. 256 unless set.

verbs.description: Send's WebSocket inflection: sends each message to a ws:// or wss:// address, and emits what the server sends back as WebSocketText or WebSocketBinary (Q158). In Meeplang: Send "wss://feed.example.com/prices" text="{msg.Text}".

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The name of the module to tap.

verbs.description: Receives everything another module emits, as if it were indented under that module. In Meeplang: Tap Schedule, or Tap Schedule @errors for its errors only.

parameters.name: condition
parameters.description: The condition, worked out for each message.

verbs.description: Passes on only the messages a condition is true for. In Meeplang: Where msg.minutesAway < 30.

parameters.name: text
parameters.description: What to write, worked out for each message. Without it, each message is written as text.

verbs.description: Writes a line for each message to standard output. A passthrough module: messages carry on downstream straight away. In Meeplang: WriteLine "{msg.route} in {msg.minutesAway} min", or just WriteLine to write each message as text.

parameters.name: by
parameters.description: The key that pairs a message from one input with one from the other. Without it, they pair in the order they come.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many messages can wait for a partner at once. When more are waiting, the one that has waited longest becomes an error. Without it, the pipeline's buffer size.

parameters.name: within
parameters.description: How long a message waits for its partner before it becomes an error. Without it, it waits until its own deadline, if it has one.

verbs.description: Pairs a message from its first input with one from its second, as a Zipped message: in the order they come, or by a key both sides share. In Meeplang, with two + lines feeding it: Zip, or Zip by msg.OrderId to pair an order with its payment.
